George MacDonald, Unspoken Sermons.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-macdonald/unspoken-sermons

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George MacDonald, the author and the annotator, died 1905.

First publication of the text used: 1867 to 1889 (SE colophon: 'Unspoken Sermons was published between 1867 and 1889 by George MacDonald.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published between 1867 and 1889, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain. Standard Ebooks also states this in its rights statement below.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication, and every person whose words are in the text died by 1925, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die, George MacDonald, died 1905; life + 100 years ended in 2005, so the text is public domain there from 1 January 2006.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
